split_method: Different textbook sections; related-topic leakage remains possible.
selection_rule: Prefer dev Evidence Hit@3, then dev Hit@1, then lower ingestion time. Prefer B in an exact B/C tie.
automatic_scoring: Exact-quote scores are conservative proxies; accept verified equivalent evidence through human review.
selection_basis: Use reviewed evidence metrics if all dev labels are complete; otherwise explicitly record exact-quote proxy selection.
test_policy: Freeze the configuration before test retrieval. Do not tune on test results.
coherence_sample_rule: First text block of at least 120 characters on each of the first 10 selected source pages; use its midpoint as a shared anchor.
limitations: Only five test questions. Coherence sampling covers Chapter 3 only.
